title: AS and resource discovery: RFC 8414 metadata, RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata, and the 401 on /.well-known/jmap
description: What a JMAP client needs to find the AS without being told: RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata on the provider's JMAP endpoint naming its AS, RFC 8414 AS metadata at the AS, and a 401 from /.well-known/jmap that points at both. The ecosystem convention (Fastmail, Stalwart) is exactly this, and RFC 8620 itself puts authentication out of scope. Nothing here issues a token; this is the discovery half, and it is what makes the rest reachable by a stock client.
